notes: Per ratified scope, SAR/CTR/CDD operational duties are treated as coordination layer rather than as primary program/'pillars' obligations. Accordingly, the CDD identification/verification specifics in § 1010.230(b) (and paragraphs (e)/(h) exclusions/exemptions it cross-references but which are not reproduced in the source text), the CTR filing/identification/anti-structuring provisions (§§ 1010.311, 1010.312, 1010.314), the funds-transfer recordkeeping rule (§ 1010.410(e)), and the FinCEN information-sharing record-search duty (§ 1010.520(b)(3)) were identified in the source text but excluded from the obligation table as boundary/coordination-layer content outside the ratified 'program-establishment' focus. Only the due-diligence-program-establishment obligations for correspondent accounts (§ 1010.610), private banking accounts (§ 1010.620), and the foreign-shell-bank correspondent-account prohibition/reasonable-steps duty (§ 1010.630(a)(1)) were extracted as in-scope program/'pillars' obligations, since they are affirmative requirements to establish AML program components rather than SAR/CTR/CDD operational duties. The linkage between the CDD rule and the underlying 31 U.S.C. 5318(h) AML compliance program requirement is preserved only as a cross-reference (interaction), consistent with the fidelity rule against harmonizing scope boundaries. Text is extracted exactly as written; no ambiguity resolution was performed.
